# Frostrek AI

> Frostrek AI delivers production-ready autonomous AI agents, LLM training, customized applications, workflow automation, and data annotation services for enterprises.

## Why Frostrek AI (Differentiators)
- **Enterprise-Grade Focus**: We don't just build chatbots; we build autonomous systems with strict zero-trust security (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA compliant).
- **Global Presence**: Headquartered in Gurugram, India, with offices in Austin, TX, and London, UK.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Experts**: We combine frontier AI models with expert data annotation and human-in-the-loop oversight to ensure 99.9% accuracy in mission-critical applications.
- **Omnichannel Deployment**: Seamless deployment across Web, WhatsApp, Messenger, and bespoke enterprise tools.

## Core Products
- [Frosty Agent](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/frosty-agent): Omnichannel intelligent agent for support and sales. Connects to your knowledge base and deploys instantly to Website and WhatsApp.
- [Hiyring](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/hiyring): Next-generation AI recruitment and hiring platform with autonomous video interviews.
- [Vedashi](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/vedashi-ecommerce): Premium, hyper-personalized online storefronts with intelligent WhatsApp cart recovery.
- [VettEdge](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/vettedge): AI-powered resume parsing and candidate vetting system that integrates into your HR workflow.

## Enterprise Solutions
- [AI Agents](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/ai-agents): End-to-end intelligent agent development for internal workflows.
- [Manufacturing Intelligence](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/manufacturing-intelligence): AI-driven operational intelligence. Digital shift handovers and quality capture replacing WhatsApp with structured data.
- [Voice AI](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/voice-ai): Enterprise-grade AI calling agents capable of handling complex regional dialects and high-volume calls.
- [Custom LLM Fine-Tuning](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/llm-model-training): Managed RLHF alignment, red-teaming, and dataset preparation services.
- [Web3 & Fintech](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/fintech-custom-wallets): Custom fintech wallets, closed-loop loyalty systems, and crypto payment integrations.
- [Multivendor Dashboard](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/multivendor-dashboard): Centralized management for multivendor ecommerce platforms.
